Read in data

```{r}
charges = read.table("charges.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",")
```

Part 1a

```{r}
plot(charges$charges, charges$tempurature, pch = 19, xlab = "Tempurature", ylab = "Charges")
```

Part 1b

```{r}
require(EnvStats)
linear_model = lm(charges ~ temperature , data = charges)
summary(linear_model)
anova(linear_model)
anovaPE(linear_model)
```

Part 1e

```{r}
require(EnvStats)
temperature_sq = charges$temperature^2
quad_model = lm(charges ~ temperature + temperature_sq, data = charges)
summary(quad_model)
anova(quad_model)
anovaPE(quad_model)
```

Part 1h

```{r}
require(EnvStats)
temperature_cubed = charges$temperature^3
cubic_model = lm(charges ~ temperature + temperature_sq + temperature_cubed, data = charges)
summary(cubic_model)
anova(cubic_model)
anovaPE(cubic_model)
```
